# eclipse-source

[All servers](../mcp-tools.md)

Version: 1.0.0. Tools: 8.

## formatFile

Formats a Java file using Eclipse's formatter settings. This applies proper indentation, spacing, line breaks, and code style according to project-specific or workspace formatter preferences. Equivalent to pressing Ctrl+Shift+F in Eclipse.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the Java file. Optional if file path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the Java file relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/MyClass.java') or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |
| lines | string | String | No | Line ranges to format (e.g., '10-20,105,150-190'). If omitted, formats entire file. |

## organizeImports

Organizes imports in a Java file using Eclipse's organize imports mechanism. This removes unused imports, adds missing imports, and sorts them according to project settings. Equivalent to pressing Ctrl+Shift+O in Eclipse.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the Java file. Optional if file path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the Java file relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/MyClass.java') or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |

## organizeImportsInPackage

Organizes imports in all Java files within a package. This is useful for cleaning up imports across multiple files at once.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the package. Optional if package is unique across projects. |
| packageName | string | String | Yes | The fully qualified package name (e.g., 'com.example.mypackage') |

## readJava

Lists the structure of a Java class: fields, methods, constructors, inner types with their line ranges and full source code. MUST be called before writeJava or removeJava to inspect the current state of the file. This prevents blind overwrites by ensuring you see the current class structure first.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project. Optional if file path is unique or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | Path to the Java file (e.g., 'src/com/example/MyClass.java') |
| className | string | String | No | Target class name within the file. Use dotted notation for inner classes (e.g., 'Outer.Inner'). Lists all top-level types if omitted. |

## removeJava

Removes named members (fields, methods, inner types) from a Java class by name. Automatically runs organize imports afterward. Returns a diff and any compilation errors. REQUIRES readJava to be called first on the target file.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project. Optional if file path is unique or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | Path to the Java file (e.g., 'src/com/example/MyClass.java') |
| className | string | String | No | Target class name for member removal. Use dotted notation for inner classes. Defaults to the primary type if omitted. |
| members | string | String | Yes | Comma-separated member names to remove (e.g., 'getData,setData,myField'). Matches fields, methods, or inner types by name. |

## removeLines

Removes line ranges from a Java file. Automatically runs organize imports afterward. Returns a diff and any compilation errors. REQUIRES readJava to be called first on the target file.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project. Optional if file path is unique or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | Path to the Java file (e.g., 'src/com/example/MyClass.java') |
| lines | string | String | Yes | Line ranges to remove (e.g., '1-5,65,100-105'). Lines are 1-based. |

## resetReadGate

Resets the readJava gate. If a filePath is provided, resets only that file. If no filePath is provided, resets all files. Use this to force re-reading a file before write/remove operations.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project. Optional. |
| filePath | string | String | No | Path to a specific file to reset, or omit to reset all files. |

## writeJava

Writes a code member (method, field, constructor, inner class) into a Java class. Parses the provided source via AST to identify the member type, then replaces an existing member with the same signature or appends it if not found. Automatically runs organize imports afterward. Returns a diff and any compilation errors. REQUIRES readJava to be called first on the target file.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project. Optional if file path is unique or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | Path to the Java file (e.g., 'src/com/example/MyClass.java') |
| className | string | String | No | Target class name within the file. Use dotted notation for inner classes (e.g., 'Outer.Inner'). Defaults to the primary type if omitted. |
| newSource | string | String | Yes | Complete source code of the member to write. Must be a valid Java class member: method, constructor, field, or inner type declaration. |
